zero_gradient_bc_xmin.description: Zero-gradient (homogeneous Neumann, du/dn=0) ghost-cell prescription at xmin for cell-centered grids (esm-spec §11.5; ESS BC kind/side matcher via the fn/dim encoding landed in ess-bps). ESS's `_discretize_bc!` builds the synthetic `bc` wrapper encoding kind->fn, side->dim, variable->arg, then runs the rule engine; the fn/dim sibling fields are matched by `_match_sibling_name`. Reflecting the nearest interior cell across the boundary makes the one-sided difference at the boundary face vanish: u_ghost = u[1] (1-based first interior cell). Analytic check: (u[1] - u_ghost)/dx = 0 = du/dn. xmin needs no dim-size binding because the nearest interior index is the constant 1.

zero_gradient_bc_xmax.description: Zero-gradient (homogeneous Neumann, du/dn=0) ghost-cell prescription at xmax: the high-side ghost reflects the last interior cell, u_ghost = u[N] (1-based), with N bound from the grid via the `bind_side_dim_size` guard (ess-bps). Analytic check: (u_ghost - u[N])/dx = 0 = du/dn. `var_has_grid` binds the variable's grid so `bind_side_dim_size` can resolve the xmax dim size.
